description: This file defines the CollectionEndpoint interface for the OrangeHRM system's API v2. It specifies methods for managing collections of resources, such as retrieving all resources, creating new ones, and deleting multiple resources, along with associated validation rule methods and exceptions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of resources, potentially throwing exceptions related to normalization, not implemented features, missing records, or access forbidden.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new resource, with potential exceptions similar to getAll.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a list of resources, possibly throwing exceptions related to normalization, not implemented features, missing records, or forbidden access.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method.
